known_findings_triage.title: UAX #9 P2/P3 directional isolate failure in paragraphBaseDirection
known_findings_triage.evidence: paragraphBaseDirection now tracks isolateDepth for \u2066..\u2068 and \u2069; "\u2067\u0627\u2069A" -> Ltr and "\u2066A\u2069\u0627" -> Rtl, matching java.text.Bidi.

known_findings_triage.title: Break-only and empty-paragraph selections rendered zero highlight rects
known_findings_triage.evidence: Geometry.breakAndEmptySelectionRects renders directional 8px*scale highlight strips for selected PARAGRAPH_BREAK and empty paragraphs.

known_findings_triage.title: paragraphForOffset(leadingAffinity=true) crossed separator and clamped negative local offset
known_findings_triage.evidence: Removed leadingAffinity cross-separator jump from paragraphForOffset; p.endOffset stays in paragraph p at local offset p.textLength.

known_findings_triage.title: referenceMeasure reused production helpers and warm TextMeasurer cache
known_findings_triage.evidence: referenceMeasure now uses an uncached TextMeasurer(cacheSize = 0), independent '\n' splitting, java.text.Bidi base direction resolution, and independent SpanStyle construction, plus hardcoded layout assertions in RtlHostChecks.

known_findings_triage.title: Scrolling composition test had no active composition (marked == null)
known_findings_triage.evidence: RtlHostChecks Section 16 injects an active Urdu composition (marked != null) and verifies both getTextLocation and getLocationOffset under a +40px scroll offset.

known_findings_triage.title: EditorSurface.geometry() returned stale cached layout after surface.setSize() before Compose repaint
known_findings_triage.evidence: Geometry and ViewState track logical hostWidth and hostHeight; surface.geometry() invalidates and re-measures immediately when surface.width or surface.height changes.

deep_risk_findings.title: Partial-commit composition abort data loss on retained original segments
deep_risk_findings.evidence: Implemented arbitrary-length segmented composition overlay (OverlaySegment / SegmentOrigin.RETAINED | REPLACEMENT) with per-epoch epochBaseSegments. 'abcd' + Selection(0,4) + inputMethod('Xcd', 1, 2) + abortComposition() -> 'Xcd'; inputMethod('abX', 1, 2) + abortComposition() -> 'abcd'.

deep_risk_findings.title: Empty-paragraph typing style stored on PARAGRAPH_BREAK inline style flags
deep_risk_findings.evidence: Separated TextUnit.paragraphStyle from TextUnit.style while keeping PARAGRAPH_BREAK.style invariant as TextStyleFlags(bold=false, italic=false); persisted in .astra v3 with v1/v2 migration.

deep_risk_findings.title: Soft-wrap boundary affinity (WrapAffinity) and wrapped-line VK_END
deep_risk_findings.evidence: Added WrapAffinity (DOWNSTREAM | UPSTREAM) to Selection and EditAction.Move; stops(g) emits (k, WrapAffinity.UPSTREAM) at soft-wrap boundaries so VK_END on wrapped line 0 reaches offset 41 on line 0.

deep_risk_findings.title: Bounded settlement watchdog, IME epoch retirement, and close/save active-composition protection
deep_risk_findings.evidence: Added checkSettlementWatchdog(timeoutMs=2000L), abortAndRetireComposition() with activeImeEpoch/imeEpoch rejection of late callbacks, and hardened WindowFiles.close() and WindowFiles.save(closeAfter=true). Withdrew prior claim that a headless queue-filling probe proved Windows OS callback loss.

deep_risk_findings.title: Claim that paragraphAttributedDisplay does not coalesce contiguous SpanStyle runs
deep_risk_findings.evidence: Refuted: DesktopEditor.kt:47-53 already coalesces contiguous identical styles (50 bold units -> 1 SpanStyle).

deep_risk_findings.title: Claim that Graphemes.stops omits caret stops for empty paragraphs
deep_risk_findings.evidence: Refuted: Graphemes.stops("a\n\nb") returns [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], including offset 2 for the empty paragraph.

deep_risk_findings.title: Claim that WindowFiles.open() replaces the current EditorEngine in place
deep_risk_findings.evidence: Refuted: WindowFiles.kt:59 opens a separate window via showEditor(initial = doc, initialPath = chosen) and never mutates the existing EditorEngine.

deep_risk_findings.title: Neutral/empty paragraph base-direction inheritance across paragraphs
deep_risk_findings.evidence: Preserved per the Stage 2 contract and RtlHostChecks.kt:292-336.

deep_risk_findings.title: Non-character keyPressed handling during active composition
deep_risk_findings.evidence: Preserved VK_LEFT navigation during composition (HostChecks.kt:35) while routing Escape to requestEndComposition() / abortAndRetireComposition().

deep_risk_findings.title: Flat whole-document buffer scaling vs production persistent tree storage
deep_risk_findings.evidence: Measured on real EditorEngine: 100 full-document text reads take 5-25 ms across 1k-20k units; production 100k+ char documents require the frozen v5 persistent rope/piece-tree.
